derivation: from G1722 (ἐν) and a derivative of G5179 (τύπος);

occurrences.text: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:
